name: KGL2BPMNClasses
title: Knowledge graph L2BPMN: classes
description: The classes of the L2BPMN layer of the SMART Guidelines knowledge graph. A node's `type` is one of these. Source: smart-base/L1/schemas/L2-BPMN.ts (migrated from smart-kg ontology/L2-BPMN/L2-BPMN.json).

concept.definition: One BPMN file as a unit -- the `bpmn:definitions` root. Shares its IRI with the l1:external-artifact for the same file, so the component that points at it and the subgraph that opens it name one resource.
One `bpmn:process`. Present as a node because a participant references it by processRef, and without it the pool-to-element attribution has nothing to travel through.

A pool: a role that owns part of the collaboration. The lifecycle BPMN has 8 and declares no laneSet at all, so the pool is the only unit of role assignment present and its @name is the sole link to a persona.

A task or sub-process. It is what a DMN usingTask href points at, what sequence flows connect, and what a DAK-level task entry describes. Sub-processes carry isSubProcess rather than getting a class of their own -- the lifecycle BPMN has exactly one.

A branch or merge. Included for connectivity rather than for a cross-model edge: a flow through a gateway with no node would point at nothing, and every reachability question over the process would break at the first decision point.
A start or end event. Same connectivity argument as gateway, plus one of its own: entry and exit points are what make 'is this task reachable' and 'does this path terminate' answerable at all.
